summary_en: This Phase III trial compares radiation therapy planned with RapidPlan, a knowledge-based planning tool, to radiation therapy planned by a dosimetrist (human-driven planning) in people with prostate cancer. Patients receive radiation therapy over 15 to 30 minutes on 5 to 44 fractions, per standard of care. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase III compara la radioterapia planificada con RapidPlan, una herramienta de planificación basada en conocimiento, con la radioterapia planificada por un dosimetrista (planificación humana), en personas con cáncer de próstata. Los pacientes reciben radioterapia durante 15 a 30 minutos en 5 a 44 fracciones, según la atención estándar. El resultado principal del estudio no se indica en el registro.
who_for: Prostate cancer confirmed by tissue (histologically confirmed)
Clinical or pathologic stage T1c to T3b with specified nodal and metastasis categories
Planned definitive radiation to the prostate or prostate bed
ECOG performance status 0 to 2 within 90 days of enrollment
not_for: Previous pelvic radiation greater than 5 Gy or planned radiation to pelvic lymph nodes
Active rectal diverticulitis, Crohn's disease affecting the rectum, or ulcerative colitis
Prior hip replacement or penile implant
Major medical, addictive, or psychiatric illness that the investigator judges will prevent consent, treatment, or follow-up; indwelling or intermittent urinary
